Eintracht.et: From Middle High German eintraht, which is a borrowing and phonetic adaptation of Middle Low German ēndracht. By surface analysis, ein (“one”) + Tracht (“load, burden”).

free entrance ticket to the exhibition.

eintönig.et: ein- (“one”) + Ton (“tone, note”) + -ig (“y”). Compare English one-note.

s: to impress upon, to din something into someone (to repeat insistently in order to persuade or make remember)

to funnel (to pour liquid through a funnel)
eintrichtern.et: ein- (“in”) + Trichter (“funnel”) + -n, literally “to pour in with a funnel”.

ein Tropfen auf den heißen Stein.et: Literally, “a drop on a hot stone”.

eintuppern.et: Pseudo-anglicism, derived from Tupperware, interpreting it by back-formation as tuppern + Ware (“product, ware”) and forming a separable verb ein- + tuppern by analogy with einwecken and eindosen.

所以，虽然哲学只能分为两个主要部分，即理论的和实践的；虽然我们关于判断力自己的原则可能要说的一切，在哲学中都必须算作理论部分，即按照自然概念的理性知识：但是，纯粹理性批判——它必须在着手建立那个体系之前，为了体系的可能而解决这一切——却由三个部分组成：纯粹知性批判、纯粹判断力批判和纯粹理性批判；这些能力之所以被称为纯粹的，是因为它们是先天立法的。
